EMPTY ON PURPOSE, 2026-08-06. The whole planning corpus was retired when the
owner replanned the product. There is no plan to enrol yet.
This is not a disabled gate. check-plan-doc-freshness.py treats the empty
state as a DEADLINE: it passes until PLAN_ENROLLMENT_DEADLINE and fails after,
so a replan that never produces a plan becomes a red build rather than a
silence. Clear it by enrolling the new plan here as 'anchored' AND naming it
in REQUIRED_ANCHORED -- not by moving the date.
status 'anchored': the document must carry a <!-- doc-freshness-anchor -->
block naming the commit it was measured at and the pathspecs it claims to
describe. The gate fails when commits touching those paths landed after the
anchor. Clearing the finding means re-measuring and advancing 'sha:'; editing
the document does not clear it.
status 'exempt': a dated, reasoned, EXPIRING escape hatch for a document that
is being migrated. An expired exemption is a failure. There is no permanent
Any markdown file under docs/ that carries an anchor block is checked whether
or not it is listed here, so opting in costs one edit.
